sloka: को भवान्देवसङ्काश आहारश्च विगर्हितः ।त्वयेदं भुज्यते सौम्य किमर्थं वक्तुमर्हसि ।। ७.७७.१९ ॥
transliteration: ko bhavāndevasaṅkāśa āhāraśca vigarhitaḥ ।tvayedaṁ bhujyate saumya kimarthaṁ vaktumarhasi ।। 7.77.19 ॥

translations.english: O god-like one, who are you, and why do you consume this reprehensible food, O gentle one, please tell me the reason.
